business_problem: replace a hard-to-scale Hadoop platform with a modern data foundation that could unify brand data, speed partner sharing, and surface customer insight for merchandising and promotions.
solution_summary: Tapestry uses Snowflake, Snowpark, Tableau, and Secure Data Sharing on Snowflake to replace a hard-to-scale Hadoop platform with a data foundation that could unify brand data, speed partner sharing, and surface customer insight for merchandising and promotions. Customer, product, transaction, and campaign data are centralized in Snowflake so marketing, merchandising, and customer-experience teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Snowpark keeps transformation and application logic close to the governed data instead of forcing the team to move workloads into separate compute environments. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Tapestry doubled ingested data sources, processes 4 billion rows daily, and cut new data-sharing setups from weeks to days while improving customer and merchandising insight.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized data platform that stores governed datasets and serves analytics or AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Snowpark
solution_components.role: Runs transformations, analytics, and application logic directly where Snowflake data already lives.

solution_components.name: Tableau
solution_components.role: Provides dashboards and self-service analytics backed by Snowflake data.

solution_components.name: Secure Data Sharing
solution_components.role: Shares governed data with partners or internal consumers without moving copies.

data_flow: customer, product, transaction, and campaign data flow into Snowflake, Snowpark, Tableau, and Secure Data Sharing; curated data, reports, and model outputs are then served to marketing, merchandising, and customer-experience teams.
business_outcome: Tapestry doubled the data sources it ingests, processes more than 4 billion rows daily, and reduced new data-sharing setups from weeks to days while supporting richer customer and merchandising insight.
